blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Controllable 3D part generation is pivotal for digital asset creation, yet existing methods lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse user workflows requiring varying levels of control. In this paper, we introduce FlexPart, a unified image-to-3D part generation framework that supports variable-granularity geometric conditions within a single model. By seamlessly integrating heterogeneous inputs, ranging from sparse points to dense bounding boxes and masks, via gated adaptive modulation, FlexPart unlocks a powerful cross-modal synergy. We also propose an asymmetric geometric guidance mechanism that leverages strong spatial priors to align representations across granularities, improving geometric consistency and facilitating inter-task synergy. Under mask conditioning on PartVerseXL, FlexPart reduces Part CD by 16.6% relative to TripoSG + SAM3D and by 10.5% relative to OmniPart, while maintaining competitive whole-mesh quality. The code can be found at https://github.com/Gucci233/FlexPart
blocks.zh: 可控3D部分生成对于数字资产创造至关重要,但现有方法缺乏灵活性,无法适应需要不同程度控制的各种用户工作流程。 在本文中,我们引入了FlexPart,一个统一的图像到3D部分生成框架,支持一个单一模型内的可变-角几何条件. FlexPart通过无缝融合各种投入,从零星点到密集的边框和口罩,通过有门的适应性调制,释放出强大的跨模式协同效应。 我们还提出一种不对称的几何指导机制,利用强大的空间前兆来调和颗粒体之间的表示,提高几何一致性,促进任务间的协同作用。 在PartVerseXL上的口罩调节下,FlexPart相对TripoSG + SAM3D减少16.6%,相对于OmniPart减少10.5%,同时保持有竞争力的全mesh质量. 该代码可在https://github.com/Gucci233/FlexPart上找到.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Perceiving objects as compositions of semantically coherent parts is essential for various tasks such as animation, simulation, and interactive editing. Unlike holistic 3D generation methods that generate whole entities [ 48 , 39 , 16 , 40 ] , image-to-3D part generation decomposes visual inputs into distinct, spatially assemblable, structurally detachable, and image-consistent 3D components.
blocks.zh: 将物体视为精密连贯的部分的构成,对于动画、模拟和互动编辑等各种任务至关重要。 与生成整个实体[48,39,16,40]的整体3D生成方法不同,图像到3D部分生成将视觉输入分解为独特的,空间化的,结构化的,与图像一致的3D组件.

blocks.en: However, this task presents significant challenges due to the inherent ambiguity of part decomposition. For example, the same object can be segmented at various granularities, and users may require different structural specifications depending on their goals. A straightforward solution is to project 2D segmentation masks [ 45 ] onto generated 3D meshes. However, such decoupled pipelines can introduce geometric inconsistencies during the lifting process. To address this limitation, recent approaches have integrated part control directly. Some methods rely on dense geometric prompts, such as pixel-wise 2D segmentation masks [ 3 , 46 , 9 ] or explicit bounding box layouts [ 8 ] . These inputs provide strong spatial constraints, enabling well-structured part generation. In contrast, other methods explore lighter forms of supervision, such as high-level prompts like part counts [ 20 ] or implicit volumetric partitioning [ 35 ] . These approaches reduce annotation effort and improve usability but often sacrifice precise spatial control.
blocks.zh: 然而,由于部分分解固有的模糊性,这项任务提出了重大挑战。 例如,同一对象可以在各种颗粒物上分解,用户可能根据目标要求不同的结构规格. 一个直截了当的解决方案就是在生成的3D meshes上进行2D分区口罩[45]的项目. 然而,这种脱钩的管道在提升过程中可能会造成几何不一致. 为了消除这一限制,最近的办法直接将部分控制结合起来。 一些方法依赖于密密的几何提示,如像素-明智的2D分割口罩[3,46,9]或明确的边框布局[8]. 这些投入提供了很强的空间限制,使部分发电结构完善。 相比之下,其他方法则探索较轻的监管形式,如部分计数[20]或隐含量分制[35]等高级提示. 这些方法减少了注解努力,提高了可用性,但往往牺牲精确的空间控制。

blocks.en: While effective within their respective domains, existing methods are typically tailored to a single prompt granularity, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (a). This specialization not only limits user flexibility by hindering seamless transitions between fine-grained control via dense masks and lightweight interaction via sparse points, but also overlooks the inherent structural relationships across different prompt modalities. Such rigidity is suboptimal, as prompts of varying granularities provide complementary information that could be jointly leveraged. This raises a fundamental question: can we develop a unified framework that accommodates variable-granularity inputs for flexible part generation, while exploiting their cross-modal synergy to enhance quality?
blocks.zh: 如图1(a)所示,现有方法虽然在各自领域有效,但通常适合单一的即时颗粒。 这种专业化不仅限制用户的灵活性,阻碍通过密集的口罩进行精细的控制与通过稀释点进行轻量级交互之间的无缝过渡,而且还忽略了不同快速方式的固有结构关系. 这种僵硬性不尽人意,因为各种颗粒的提示提供了可联合利用的补充信息。 这提出了一个根本问题:我们能否制定一个统一框架,为灵活的部分生成提供可变偏重性投入,同时利用其跨模式的协同作用来提高质量?

blocks.en: Driven by this motivation, we propose FlexPart , a unified framework for controllable 3D part generation. As shown in Fig. 1 (a), FlexPart integrates sparse points, bounding boxes, and masks into a single Diffusion Transformer (DiT) via gated adaptive modulation. Joint training improves generation quality across prompt granularities. To further amplify this synergy, we introduce an Asymmetric Geometric Guidance mechanism. During training, it employs differentiable optimal transport to let strong spatial priors (masks/boxes) explicitly supervise the ambiguous representations of sparse points. The resulting model supports different prompt types at inference without retraining.
blocks.zh: 基于这一动机,我们提出FlexPart,一个可控制3D部分生成的统一框架. 如图1(a)所示,FlexPart通过闸口适应性调制,将稀疏点,边框,口罩整合成一个单一的传播变形器(DIT). 联合培训可提高速成颗粒体的生成质量。 为了进一步扩大这种协同作用,我们引入了一个不对称几何指导机制。 在培训期间,它采用不同的最佳运输方式,让强力的空间前兆(masks/boxes)明确监督稀少点的模糊表述。 由此产生的模型支持不同的即时类型,无需再培训即可推论.

blocks.en: By consolidating diverse geometric constraints, FlexPart establishes a unified paradigm for versatile part creation with variable granularity. Under mask conditioning on PartVerseXL, FlexPart reduces Part CD by 16.6% relative to TripoSG + SAM3D and by 10.5% relative to OmniPart. Thanks to the learned cross-modal synergy, it remains highly competitive even with significantly sparser prompts. Ultimately, FlexPart delivers superior part-level generation quality (Fig. 1 (b)) while preserving strong whole-mesh reconstruction fidelity.
blocks.zh: FlexPart通过整合多种几何限制,为多功能部分的生成建立了统一的范式,具有可变颗粒性. 在PartVerseXL的口罩配置下,FlexPart将部分CD相对TripoSG + SAM3D减少16.6%,相对OmniPart减少10.5%。 由于学习到的跨模式协同效应,即使在显著较少的提示下,它仍然具有很高的竞争力。 归根结底,FlexPart提供优异的半层生成质量(图1(b)),同时保持强大的整体重建忠诚。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: 1) We propose FlexPart, the first unified framework integrating point, box, and mask prompts into a single DiT to unlock cross-modal synergy for controllable 3D part generation; 2) We devise an Asymmetric Geometric Guidance mechanism that effectively transfers structural knowledge from dense priors to enhance the spatial reasoning of sparse inputs; 3) We demonstrate that our method achieves superior generation quality and geometric consistency compared to existing state-of-the-art approaches across diverse input modalities.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下: 1)我们提议FlexPart,第一个统一的框架集成点,框,面罩促使一个单一的DiT为可控3D部分生成解锁跨模式协同效应;2)我们设计了一个不对称几何指导机制,有效地将结构知识从稠密的前身转移出去,以加强稀疏投入的空间推理;3)我们表明,我们的方法与不同输入模式的现有最新方法相比,实现了更高的生成质量和几何一致性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
General 3D Mesh Generation. Early 3D generation methods relied on optimization-based pipelines, using Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) to distill 2D priors into implicit 3D representations [ 28 , 19 , 38 , 37 ] . While pioneering, these approaches often suffer from slow convergence and geometric artifacts. Feed-forward Large Reconstruction Models (LRMs) [ 11 , 34 ] improve efficiency by directly predicting 3D representations from images.
Native 3D generative models use compact latent representations [ 47 , 48 , 5 ] to support efficient diffusion training. Recent methods [ 40 , 42 , 49 , 16 ] further improve geometric fidelity through structured sparse latents or flow matching. These object-level generators typically produce holistic meshes without explicit part decomposition, limiting part-level interaction and editing.
Complementary work connects 3D analysis and generation. ROAD transfers discriminative semantic and structural priors to a generative model through reciprocal-objective alignment [ 24 ] , while HERMES and HERMES++ jointly model scene understanding and future geometry generation in autonomous driving [ 52 , 51 ] . Our work focuses on joint learning across geometric prompt granularities for controllable object-part generation.
blocks.zh:
3D Mesh世代将军. 早期的3D生成方法依赖于基于优化的管道,使用分数分解分解取样法(SDS)将2D前缀分解为隐含的3D表示[28,19,38,37]. 这些方法虽然具有开拓性,但往往受到缓慢趋同和几何文物的影响。 Feed-forward大型重建模型(LRM)[11,34]通过直接预测图像中的3D表示来提高效率.
原生3D基因模型使用紧凑的潜在表示[47、48、5]支持有效的传播培训。 最近的方法[40、42、49、16]通过结构化的稀疏潜伏或流量匹配,进一步改善几何忠诚度。 这些对象级的生成器一般产生整体的中间体,没有明显的部分分解,限制了部分级的相互作用和编辑.
辅助工作连接三维分析和生成. ROAD通过对等-目标对齐[24]将歧视性语义和结构前缀转移至基因模型,而HERMES和HERMES++在自主驱动中联合模型场景理解和未来几何生成[52,51]. 我们的工作重点是在几何速成颗粒体上进行联合学习,以生成可控物体。

blocks.en:
3D Shape Analysis and Part Segmentation. Point-cloud analysis has advanced through efficient state-space backbones such as PointMamba [ 18 ] and model adaptation methods, including dynamic adapters with prompt tuning [ 53 ] , spectral-domain fine-tuning [ 17 ] , and input-aware parameter adaptation for 3D scenes [ 23 ] . Here, learned prompts used for model adaptation differ from the user-provided geometric prompts considered in our work. Language-driven approaches such as ShapeLLM [ 30 ] and Kestrel [ 2 ] further support object understanding and part-aware grounding.
For part decomposition, supervised methods [ 26 , 29 ] analyze existing shapes, while other approaches lift 2D foundation model priors, such as SAM [ 14 ] and GLIP [ 15 ] , to 3D [ 45 , 1 , 13 , 21 , 36 , 50 ] . Recent methods learn open-world 3D feature fields or native segmentation networks [ 44 , 22 , 25 ] . Conventional segmentation primarily identifies regions of existing surfaces. HoloPart [ 43 ] extends this setting by completing initially segmented regions into full 3D parts using a generative model. These pipelines rely on input geometry, whereas our task is to generate complete parts directly from an image and geometric prompts.
blocks.zh:
3D 形状分析和部分分割。 点云分析通过PointMamba[18]等高效的状态空间主干线和模型适应方法,包括动态适配器,即时调制[53],光谱域微调[17],以及3D场景的输入-感知参数适应[23],都得到了推进. 在这方面,用于模型适应的学习到的提示不同于我们工作中考虑的用户提供的几何提示。 语言驱动的方法如ShapeLLM[30]和Kestrel[2]进一步支持对象理解和部分意识地基.
就部分分解而言,受监督的方法[26,29]分析现有形状,而其他方法将2D基础模型的前身,如SAM[14]和GLIP[15],提升至3D[45,1,13,21,36,50]. 近代方法学习开放世界3D特征场或本土分块网络[44,22,25]. 常规分割主要确定现有表面的区域。 HoloPart [43] 扩展了这种设置,使用基因模型将最初分割的区域完成为完整的3D部分. 这些管道依赖于输入几何,而我们的任务是从图像和几何提示直接生成完整的部件.

blocks.en:
Part-level 3D Generation. Recent generative models synthesize objects as compositions of semantic components, with different ways of specifying part structure. Mask- and layout-conditioned methods [ 9 , 46 , 8 ] provide explicit spatial control, although precise masks or layouts can require substantial annotation effort. AutoPartGen [ 4 ] generates parts autoregressively and supports conditioning on images, part masks, or existing 3D objects. In a related programmatic reconstruction setting, MeshCoder [ 6 ] uses an LLM to translate point clouds into editable, part-structured mesh code.
Methods such as PartCrafter [ 20 ] and PartPacker [ 35 ] internalize part decomposition within the generative process without requiring explicit geometric prompts. This simplifies interaction but offers less direct control over spatial part boundaries. A related challenge arises in count-controlled video generation, where NUMINA [ 33 ] uses countable latent layouts to improve numerical alignment, illustrating the value of spatial structure for abstract count-based control. Our framework unifies point, box, and mask prompts within one model, allowing users to choose the level of spatial control while benefiting from joint multi-granularity training.
blocks.zh:
分级3D生成. 最近的基因模型将物体合成成语义元件的成分,有不同的方式指定部分结构. 遮罩和布局条件化方法[9,46,8]提供了明确的空间控制,尽管精确的遮罩或布局可能需要大量的注解努力. AutoPartGen [4] 自动地生成部件,并支持在图像,部分口罩,或现有3D对象上的配置. 在相关的程序重建设置中,MeshCoder [6] 使用LLM将点云翻译为可编辑的,部分结构的网格代码.
方法如PartCrafter [20] 和PartPacker [35] 在基因分解过程中将部分分解内化而不需要明显的几何提示. 这简化了相互作用,但对空间部分边界的直接控制较少。 一个相关的挑战出现在计数控制视频生成中,NUMINA[33]使用可计数的潜在布局来改进数值对齐,说明空间结构对抽象计数控制的价值. 我们的框架将点、框和遮罩统一在一个模型内,使用户能够选择空间控制水平,同时受益于联合多角性培训。

Partial Optimal Transport. Standard OT enforces strict mass conservation, requiring all elements to be matched, which is ill-suited for scenarios with occlusions or noise. Partial OT addresses this by introducing a dustbin mechanism to absorb unmatched mass.

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Our method presents a unified multi-granularity framework for controllable image-to-3D part generation, accommodating diverse geometric user inputs, such as point prompts, 2D bounding boxes, and 2D masks, within a single model. Built upon the DiT architecture, FlexPart leverages a Gated Adaptive Layer Normalization (Gated AdaLN) mechanism to inject these geometric conditions, enabling unified modeling of heterogeneous inputs with varying precision. To further support this versatility, we incorporate a geometric guidance mechanism to maintain robustness under weak supervision. The overall architecture is illustrated in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们的方法为可控图像到3D部分生成提供了统一的多引力框架,在单一的模型内容纳各种各样的几何用户输入,如点提示,2D边框,2D口罩. FlexPart在DiT架构的基础上,利用了Gated适应性地层正常化(Gated AdaLN)机制来注入这些几何条件,从而能够以不同精度对各种输入进行统一模型。 为了进一步支持这种多面性,我们采用了几何指导机制,在薄弱的监督下保持稳健性。 图2显示了总体结构。

blocks.en: 4.1 Gated Adaptive Modulation
blocks.zh: 4.1 适应性调制

blocks.en: Prompt Definition and Encoding. We consider multiple geometric prompt types for part-level structure, including point, box, and mask prompts. For each part i i , we denote their embeddings as 𝐞 i point , 𝐞 i box , 𝐞 i mask ∈ ℝ D \mathbf{e}_{i}^{\mathrm{point}},\mathbf{e}_{i}^{\mathrm{box}},\mathbf{e}_{i}^{\mathrm{mask}}\in\mathbb{R}^{D} , all produced by lightweight modality-specific encoders. Point prompts are encoded via Gaussian Fourier features followed by an MLP to capture continuous 2D locations. Box prompts encode top-left and bottom-right corners separately with a learnable corner-type embedding inspired by SAM [ 14 ] . Mask prompts are processed using a small CNN with global average pooling to obtain compact representations. These encoders provide expressive, lightweight representations.

blocks.en: 5.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 5.1 执行细节

blocks.en:
We use a pretrained 3D VAE from TripoSG [ 16 ] to obtain part latents. Each part is encoded into latent tokens following 3DShape2VecSet [ 47 ] .
Following PartCrafter [ 20 ] , we initialize the generative backbone with pretrained TripoSG [ 16 ] weights and fine-tune it using the following two-stage training strategy.
We train FlexPart on a composite dataset derived from Objaverse [ 7 ] and PartVerseXL [ 8 ] .
Stage 1 targets objects with 1–8 parts, each encoded with 512 tokens. To ensure robustness against suboptimal placement, we randomly sample points within masks and apply a 0.5 dropout rate to both boxes and masks. Stage 2 scales to 2–16 parts using 1024 tokens per part to handle varying granularities. In this stage, we set the dropout probability to 0.1 for points and 0.7 for masks, similar to [ 31 , 12 ] . For bounding boxes, we implement a mixed dropping strategy with a probability of 0.25 for full dropout, and 0.25 for partial masking applied to half of the parts. Training is conducted on 8 NVIDIA H20 GPUs with a batch size of 256, using learning rates of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} for the two stages, respectively.

blocks.en: To assess generalization, we conduct evaluations on a held-out test set from PartVerseXL [ 8 ] and PartObjaverse-Tiny [ 44 ] , ensuring strict disjointness from the training set. For each dataset, we select the view that maximizes the product of visible pixel count and number of visible parts, ensuring sufficient part coverage.
blocks.zh: 为了评估通用性,我们对从PartVerseXL [8]和PartObjaverse-Tiny [44] 进行的搁置测试进行评价,确保与培训的严格脱节。 对于每个数据集,我们选择的视图可以最大限度地实现可见像素计数的产物和可见部件的数量,确保足够的部分覆盖.

blocks.en: Whole Mesh Evaluation Metrics. We first assemble the generated parts into a complete mesh and evaluate overall geometric quality using Chamfer Distance (CD) and F-Score, where F-Score is computed with a distance threshold of 0.1. Semantic consistency between the generated mesh and the input image is measured using ULIP [ 41 ] .
blocks.zh: 全网评价计量. 我们首先用Chamfer距离(CD)和F-Score(F-Score)将生成的部件组装成完整的网格,并评价总体几何质量,其中F-Score的计算阈值为0.1。 生成的网格和输入图像之间的语义一致性用ULIP[41]测量.

blocks.en: Part-level Evaluation Metrics. A primary challenge in evaluating parts is that the number of generated components often differs from the ground truth. To ensure a fair comparison, we first filter out ground truth parts that are fully occluded in the input image. We apply CD-based Hungarian matching between the remaining ground-truth parts and generated parts to obtain one-to-one correspondences. We compute part-level metrics only over matched pairs; unmatched ground-truth and generated parts are excluded without additional penalties. Based on these matched pairs, we report Part CD to measure geometric deviation. Furthermore, we evaluate spatial alignment using part-level bounding-box IoU (IoU B ) for coarse extent, and surface-based voxel IoU (IoU V ) for fine-grained overlap. To handle non-watertight geometry, we define occupancy based on the distance field rather than interior filling. Specifically, we use a voxel grid with a pitch of h vox = 0.03 h_{\mathrm{vox}}=0.03 , where a voxel is considered occupied if its distance to the nearest mesh surface is less than or equal to h vox h_{\mathrm{vox}} . Unless otherwise stated, benchmark box inputs are derived from ground-truth masks, and points are sampled from the corresponding mask regions.
blocks.zh: 分级评价计量. 评估部分的主要挑战是生成部分的数量往往与地面真相不同。 为了确保公平比较,我们首先过滤出输入图像中完全占据的地面真理部分. 我们采用基于CD的匈牙利语在剩余地面真实部分和生成部分之间进行匹配,以获得一对一的通信。 我们只通过匹配的对来计算部分层面的衡量标准;没有匹配的地面事实和生成的部件不计入额外处罚。 基于这些配对,我们报告部分CD,以测量几何偏差。 此外,我们利用部分界限框IoU(IoU B)对粗度进行空间配对,并使用表面的Voxel IoU(IoU V)对细纹重叠进行评估。 为了处理非水密几何,我们根据距离场而不是内部填充来定义占用. 具体来说,我们使用一个 voxel 网格,其发音为 h vox = 0.03 h_{\ mathrm{vox}}= 0.03,如果一个 voxel 与最近的网格表面的距离小于或等于 hvox h_{\ mathrm{vox}}],则该网格被认为是占用的. 除非另有说明,基准箱输入来源于地面真实的口罩,点数取自相应的口罩区域.

blocks.en: We compare FlexPart against six state-of-the-art methods, including two holistic mesh generation models [ 40 , 16 ] and four native part-based generation approaches [ 20 , 35 , 46 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了FlexPart与6种最先进的方法,包括两种整体的网格生成模型[40,16]和四种本土部分生成方法[20,35,46,8].

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Qualitative results of different methods. The upper row shows exploded views for inspecting individual parts, and the lower row shows the assembled meshes. Our method uses masks as input, while other methods are evaluated with their respective input conditions.

blocks.en:
Part-level Mesh Quality. We first evaluate the geometric fidelity of individual parts (Tab. 1 ) to assess controllable part generation.
For comparison with whole-mesh generation methods, we employ SAM3D [ 45 ] to project multi-view masks onto their generated meshes for part segmentation. This post-hoc lifting process often introduces geometric inconsistencies, significantly degrading part-level accuracy.
In contrast, FlexPart directly infers compact part geometry. Under the same mask condition, our method outperforms OmniPart by a large margin, reducing Part CD on PartVerseXL by 10.5%. This improvement is consistent with the benefits of direct part generation: OmniPart uses intermediate axis-aligned 3D boxes, which can enclose substantial empty space around non-axis-aligned shapes.
blocks.zh:
部分级别 Mesh 质量. 我们首先评估单个部分的几何忠诚度(第1段),以评估可控制的部分生成。
与全mesh生成方法相比,我们使用SAM3D[45]将多视图口罩投射到它们生成的网膜上进行部分分解. 这种加热后提升过程经常引入几何不一致,显著降低了部分水平的准确性.
相比之下,FlexPart直接推断出紧凑的部分几何. 在同一口罩条件下,我们的方法比OmniPart的成绩大得多,将PartVerseXL上的Part CD减少了10.5%. 这一改进符合直接部分生成的好处: OmniPart使用中间轴对齐的3D盒,可以将实质性的空格围在不轴对齐的形状上.

blocks.en: Crucially, FlexPart maintains robust performance across varying input granularities. Relaxing the condition from masks to boxes yields stable quality, with Part CD degrading by merely 3.5% on PartVerseXL. Even under these weaker priors, FlexPart achieves better Part CD and Part IoU B than structurally unconstrained methods like PartPacker. FullPart is excluded here due to its reliance on 3D bounding boxes. A fairer evaluation under controlled settings is provided in Sec. 6.2 .
blocks.zh: 关键是,FlexPart在各种输入颗粒方面保持强劲的性能。 从口罩到盒子的减速能产生稳定的质量,部分CD在PartVerseXL上只降低3.5%. 即使在这些较弱的前科之下,FlexPart也比PartPacker这样的结构上不受约束的方法更能实现Part CD和Part IoU B. FullPart在此被排除在外,因为它依赖于三维边框. 第6.2节提供了在受控环境下更公平的评价。

blocks.en: Whole Mesh Quality. Complementing our superior part-level performance, we further assess the global quality of the assembled meshes. As shown in Tab. 2 , FlexPart achieves strong and consistent mesh-level quality across both benchmarks. On PartVerseXL, we achieve a Mean CD of 0.1418, surpassing OmniPart by 8%, indicating that our improvements in local part precision translate into better global geometric accuracy. On PartObjaverse-Tiny, while some specialized methods achieve marginally better results, FlexPart remains highly competitive. These results show that FlexPart supports flexible part control while maintaining competitive whole-mesh quality.
blocks.zh: 全网质量. 我们进一步评估了集合体的全球质量。 如塔布所示. 2,FlexPart在两个基准中都实现了强和一致的网格质量. 在PartVerseXL上,我们实现了0.1418的均分CD,超过OmniPart8%,这表明我们局部部分精度的提高转化为更好的全球几何精度. 关于Partobjaverse-Tiny,虽然一些专门方法取得了略好的结果,但FlexPart仍然具有很高的竞争力。 这些结果显示FlexPart支持灵活的部分控制,同时保持有竞争力的全梅质量.

blocks.en: Qualitative Results. Fig. 3 presents qualitative comparisons across diverse categories. FullPart provides rough layout control via boxes but often yields inaccurate shapes. PartPacker achieves decent global geometry but lacks explicit control to match user-specified structures. OmniPart tends to distort meshes, deviating noticeably from inputs, while PartCrafter, limited to part-count conditioning, struggles to align with intended divisions. In contrast, FlexPart generates distinct and semantically meaningful parts, ensuring visual realism and structural coherence suitable for downstream editing.
blocks.zh: 定性结果. 图3列出了不同类别之间的质量比较。 FullPart通过盒提供粗糙的布局控制,但往往产生不准确的形状. PartPacker实现体面的全局几何,但缺乏与用户指定结构匹配的明确控制. OmniPart倾向于扭曲meshes,明显偏离投入,而PartCrafter则仅限于部分计数条件,挣扎着与预期的划分保持一致. 相比之下,FlexPart则产生不同且有成像意义的部分,确保视觉现实主义和结构一致性适合下游编辑.

blocks.en: 6.2 Analysis and Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 6.2 分析和分析研究

blocks.en: To investigate the architecture design, we conduct ablation studies on PartVerseXL unless otherwise specified. Default settings are marked in gray .
blocks.zh: 为了调查建筑设计,除非另有说明,否则我们将对PartVerseXL进行开发研究。 默认设置以灰色标记 。

blocks.en: Effect of Multi-granularity Synergy. Tab. 3 demonstrates that our framework achieves deep cross-modal synergy instead of a naive combination of conditions. Specifically, stronger geometric priors effectively guide weaker ones during training. Our joint model improves Point only inference by 7.9% in IoU V and 6.1% in CD because it internalizes precise boundary constraints from dense inputs. Furthermore, joint training consistently outperforms single-modality models across all evaluation settings. For example, under mask conditioning, the unified model reduces Part CD from 0.3224 for the mask-only training baseline to 0.2938. These results confirm that FlexPart learns integrated semantics in a shared space. This formulation provides a versatile solution that maintains high geometric fidelity across diverse interaction modes. Fig. 4 illustrates robust, semantically consistent results across prompt granularities.
blocks.zh: 多边性的影响 协同. 附表3表明,我们的框架实现了深层次的跨模式协同,而不是天真地组合各种条件。 具体而言,较强的几何前科有效地指导了训练中较弱的前科。 我们的联合模型在IoU V中只改进了点推论7.9%,在CD中改进了6.1%,因为它将来自密集输入的精确边界限制内部化。 此外,在所有评价环境中,联合培训的业绩始终高于单一模式模式。 例如,在口罩调节下,统一型号将仅用于口罩训练基线的CD部分从0.3224减少到0.2938. 这些结果证实了FlexPart在共享空间中学习集成语义. 这种提法提供了一个多用途的解决办法,在各种互动模式中保持高度的几何忠诚。 图4显示了快速颗粒体的有力、整体一致的结果。

blocks.en: Effect of Asymmetric Geometric Guidance. Building upon the observed multi-granularity synergy, we evaluate the proposed Asymmetric Geometric Guidance by ablating the auxiliary alignment loss. As shown in Tab. 4 , it significantly improves performance under sparse point prompts, yielding gains of 7.9% in Part IoU B and 5.0% in Part IoU V over the baseline. This indicates that OT-based alignment effectively transfers structural priors from dense annotations to regularize learning from sparse inputs. Performance under mask conditions remains comparable, suggesting positive cross-granularity transfer without conflict. The guidance operates only during training, with no inference overhead.
blocks.zh: 不对称几何指导的效果. 在观测到的多引力协同的基础上,我们评估了拟议的不对称几何指导,将辅助对齐损失分解出来。 如图4所示,在零点提示下,业绩显著改善,IoU B部分收益7.9%,IoU部分收益5.0%。 超过基线。 这表明,基于OT的调整有效地将结构前科从密集的说明转移到从稀少的投入中学习的规范化。 口罩条件下的性能仍然可以比较,这表明正面的跨角转移没有冲突. 指导只在培训期间运作,没有间接费用。

blocks.zh: 表5:在PartObjaverse-Tiny基准上与3D框条件下的FullPart进行比较。

blocks.en: Analysis of Stronger 3D Conditions. Although our primary focus is on generating 3D parts from lightweight 2D inputs, we also evaluate FlexPart under explicit 3D constraints. For a fair comparison with FullPart, which uses 3D bounding boxes, we retrain a variant conditioned solely on 3D boxes and evaluate it on PartObjaverse-Tiny. As shown in Tab. 5 , our method outperforms FullPart on most metrics under the same supervision. This result demonstrates that Gated AdaLN handles both sparse 2D inputs and explicit 3D constraints.
blocks.zh: 分析更强的立体条件。 虽然我们的首要重点是从轻量级2D输入中生成3D部件,但我们也在明确的3D限制下评价FlexPart. 为了与FullPart进行公平比较,它使用3D绑定框,我们重新训练一个完全以3D框为条件的变体,并在PartObjaverse-Tiny上加以评价. 如Tab.5所示,我们的方法在同一个监督下,在大多数度量标准上都超过了全部部分。 这一结果表明,Gated AdaLN既处理稀少的二维输入,又处理明确的三维限制。

blocks.en: Analysis of SAM-based Alternatives. A seemingly straightforward alternative is to convert sparse prompts into dense masks using 2D segmentation models (e.g., SAM) before 3D generation. However, such cascaded pipelines are inherently limited: lacking 3D part-level semantics, SAM often produces localized fragments rather than complete functional parts, leading to accumulated errors and degraded geometry. In contrast, FlexPart directly models heterogeneous conditions end-to-end, avoiding intermediate information loss and enabling consistent part-level generation from sparse prompts. Detailed analyses are provided in App. H .
blocks.zh: 分析基于SAM的替代品。 一个看似直截了当的替代品是在3D生成前使用2D分解模型(如SAM)将稀疏的导体转化为密集的口罩. 然而,这种级联式的输油管本质上是有限的:缺少3D级部分语义,SAM经常产生局部碎片而不是完整的功能部件,导致累积错误和几何学退化. 相比之下,FlexPart直接模拟了不同条件的端到端,避免中间信息丢失,并且能够从稀疏的导电符中产生一致的半层生成. 详细分析载于App.H。

blocks.en: Robustness to Input Variations. Perturbing the position and size of 2D boxes by up to 20% increases Part CD from 0.3042 to 0.3171, while Part IoU V changes from 0.2078 to 0.2032. Providing boxes for half of the parts and points for the remainder yields Part CD of 0.3287. Mixing masks for half of the parts with boxes for the rest achieves Part CD of 0.3190, despite this combination being unseen during training. These results support generation with noisy and heterogeneous prompts. A complementary study evaluates joint point-and-box inputs from three annotators on 50 PartObjaverse-Tiny objects. Full protocols and results, including count-only inputs, are provided in App. D and E .
blocks.zh: 强健到输入变化。 扰动2D盒的位置和大小可达20%,将部分CD从0.3042增加到0.3171,而部分IoU V则从0.2078变为0.2032. 提供一半零部件和其余部分的点数的盒,部分CD为0.3287。 一半部件的口罩与其余部分的盒子混合,达到0.3190的CD部分,尽管这种口罩在训练期间是看不见的. 这些成果用吵闹的、多样的提示支持产生。 一项补充研究评价了三个注释员对50个PartObjaverse-Tiny天体的联合点和框投入。 App.D和E.提供了完整的协议和结果,包括只计数输入。

blocks.en: Sensitivity of Point Prompts. We evaluate four point-placement strategies on PartVerseXL: Center (the part-mask centroid), Edge (near the part boundary), Offset (a perturbed centroid), and Cluster (the patch center closest to the object-level geometric center). Under point-only input, switching from Center to Edge increases Part CD from 0.3302 to 0.4190 and reduces Part IoU V from 0.1905 to 0.1342. With additional box or mask prompts, Part CD varies across the four strategies within 0.3036–0.3178 and 0.2995–0.3087, respectively. Stronger geometric prompts therefore reduce sensitivity to point placement. Experimental details and quantitative and qualitative results appear in App. G .
blocks.zh: 点提示的灵敏度. 我们评价在PartVerseXL上的4个定位策略:Center(半掩体中间机器人),Edge(靠近部分边界),Offset(一个扰动的中间机器人)和Cluster(最接近物体级几何中心的补丁中心). 在点数输入下,从Centre到Edge的切换将部分CD从0.3302增加到0.4190,并将部分IoU V从0.1905减少到0.1342. 有了额外的盒子或口罩提示,CD部分在4个战略中各不相同,分别为0.3036-0.3178和0.2995-0.3087。 因此,更强的几何提示降低了点位置的敏感性。 实验细节和定量及定性结果见App.G.。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced FlexPart, a unified framework for controllable image-to-3D part generation with geometric prompts at varying granularities. Gated adaptive modulation integrates heterogeneous prompts within a single model, while Asymmetric Geometric Guidance uses strong spatial priors to improve sparse point representations during training. Experiments demonstrate improved part-level geometric quality and competitive whole-mesh fidelity across prompt conditions. These results support joint multi-granularity learning as a practical approach to flexible 3D part generation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了FlexPart,一个统一的框架,用于在不同颗粒上具有几何提示的可控图像到3D部分生成. 适应性调制结合了单一模型中的各种提示,而非对称几何指导则使用强空间前兆来改进训练期间的稀有点表示. 实验表明,部分几何质量有所改善,在各种快速条件下具有竞争力的整体忠诚。 这些成果支持联合多引力学习,作为灵活3D部分生成的实用方法.

blocks.en: Limitations. Occlusion handling remains challenging. Single-view 2D conditions provide limited depth cues, and the model may place occluded parts incorrectly in visible regions. Improving spatial reasoning under occlusion is a direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 限制。 隐蔽性处理仍然具有挑战性。 单景2D条件提供了有限的深度提示,模型可能不正确地将占有的部分放置在可见的区域. 改进隔离下的空间推理是未来工作的方向。

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Preparation and Benchmark Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集编制和基准细节

blocks.en: Data Preparation. We construct the training set from subsets of Objaverse [ 7 ] and PartVerseXL [ 8 ] , totaling approximately 250K 3D models. Due to batch-wise part-packing during training, about 180K models are effectively used. The Objaverse subset provides heterogeneous annotations, where some models contain only complete object meshes while others include part-level meshes. PartVerseXL complements this with densely and carefully annotated part-level meshes. Since most Objaverse meshes are non-watertight, we convert all models into watertight representations, following prior work [ 5 , 16 , 42 , 49 ] , showing that watertight geometry leads to more stable training and improved generation quality. For each mesh, multiple viewpoints are rendered, and the view with the largest visible foreground area is selected as the training image.
blocks.zh: 数据编制. 我们从Objaverse [7] 和PartVerseXL [8] 的子集中构建培训集,总计约250K 3D型号. 由于在训练期间分批进行部分包装,约180K型号被有效使用. Objaverse子集提供了不同的说明,一些模型只包含完整的对象网格,而另一些则包含部分级的网格. PartVerseXL用密集和精心注释的半层元件来补充这一点. 由于大多数Objaverse meshes是非水密的,我们把所有的模型转换成水密的表示,在之前的工作之后[5,16,42,49],表明水密的几何学导致训练更加稳定,生成质量得到改善. 对于每个网格,会渲染多种观点,并且选择具有最大可见前景区域的视图作为训练图像.

blocks.en: For the selected view, we generate 2D part visibility masks via ID-based rendering. Each part is rendered with a unique color, and depth buffering naturally resolves inter-part occlusions. The rendered image is decoded into a part ID map, from which binary visibility masks are extracted. Bounding boxes and point prompts are then derived directly from the corresponding masks, enabling unified geometric supervision at multiple granularities. To simulate user interactions, we sample 10 points within each mask and select the one nearest its centroid.
blocks.zh: 对于选定的视图,我们通过基于ID的渲染生成2D部分可见度口罩. 每个部分都是用独特的颜色制成的,深度缓冲会自然地解决段间杂化. 渲染的图像被解码成一部分ID地图,从中提取二进制可见度口罩. 然后直接从相应的口罩中衍生出捆绑箱和点提示,从而可以在多个颗粒上进行统一的几何监督. 为了模拟用户的交互作用,我们在每个面具内抽取10个点,并选择离它的中间机器人最近的一个点.

blocks.en: Benchmarks. For evaluation, we construct benchmark subsets to test generalization. From PartVerseXL [ 8 ] , which provides high-quality part annotations, we create a held-out test set with no overlap with our training data by randomly selecting 100 shapes with no more than 16 annotated parts, matching the maximum part count used during training. We also evaluate on PartObjaverse-Tiny [ 44 ] , a publicly available part-annotated dataset, including all shapes with up to 16 parts. Although some annotations in PartObjaverse-Tiny are less precise, it provides a complementary setting for assessing part-level generalization. For each dataset, we select the view that maximizes the product of visible pixel count and the number of visible parts, ensuring an informative view with sufficient part coverage. Before computing geometric metrics, we align each generated mesh to its ground-truth counterpart using rigid Iterative Closest Point.
blocks.zh: 基准。 为了评价,我们构建基准子集,以测试概括性。 从提供高质量部分说明的PartVerseXL [8],我们通过随机选择不超过16个注释部分的100个形状,匹配培训期间使用的最大部分计数,创建了与我们的培训数据没有重叠的搁置测试集. 我们还在 PartObjaverse-Tiny [44] 上评估,这是一个公开的附加说明的部分数据集,包括最多16个部分的所有形状。 虽然PartObjaverse-Tiny中的一些说明不太精确,但它为评估部分层面的概括提供了补充性环境. 对于每个数据集,我们选择一个视图,使可见像素计数的产物和可见部分的数量最大化,确保信息性视图有足够的部分覆盖. 在计算几何度量之前,我们用刚性惯性闭合点,将每个生成的网点与地面真实对应点对齐。

blocks.en: A.1 Evaluation Metric Definitions
blocks.zh: A.1 评价计量定义

blocks.en: Before ICP, each shape is normalized to fit within [ − 1 , 1 ] 3 [-1,1]^{3} so that its longest bounding-box side is 2, with no additional scaling during rigid alignment.

blocks.en: Whole Mesh Evaluation Metrics. Whole CD is the symmetric unsquared L2 Chamfer distance over 10K surface samples. For sampled point sets X X and Y Y , CD ⁡ ( X , Y ) = \displaystyle\operatorname{CD}(X,Y)={} 1 | X | ​ ∑ x ∈ X min y ∈ Y ⁡ ‖ x − y ‖ 2 \displaystyle\frac{1}{|X|}\sum_{x\in X}\min_{y\in Y}\|x-y\|_{2} + 1 | Y | ∑ y ∈ Y min x ∈ X ∥ y − x ∥ 2 . \displaystyle+\frac{1}{|Y|}\sum_{y\in Y}\min_{x\in X}\|y-x\|_{2}. (10) F-Score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall at distance threshold 0.1 (5% of the normalized longest side). ULIP [ 41 ] measures semantic consistency with the input image. The same CD definition is used for matched part pairs.

Part-level Evaluation Metrics. A primary challenge in evaluating parts is that the number of generated components often differs from the ground truth. To ensure a fair comparison, we first filter out ground truth parts that are fully occluded in the input image. We apply CD-based Hungarian matching between the remaining ground-truth parts and generated parts to obtain one-to-one correspondences. We compute part-level metrics only over matched pairs; unmatched ground-truth and generated parts are excluded without additional penalties. Based on these matched pairs, we report Part CD to measure geometric deviation. Furthermore, we evaluate spatial alignment using part-level bounding-box IoU (IoU B ) for coarse extent, and surface-based voxel IoU (IoU V ) for fine-grained overlap. To handle non-watertight geometry, we define occupancy based on the distance field rather than interior filling. Specifically, we use a voxel grid with a pitch of h vox = 0.03 h_{\mathrm{vox}}=0.03 , where a voxel is considered occupied if its distance to the nearest mesh surface is less than or equal to h vox h_{\mathrm{vox}} . The normalized longest axis spans approximately 67 voxels at this pitch, which is fixed across all methods. Unless otherwise stated, benchmark boxes are derived from masks, and points are sampled from the corresponding mask regions.
blocks.zh: 分级评价计量. 评估部分的主要挑战是生成部分的数量往往与地面真相不同。 为了确保公平比较,我们首先过滤出输入图像中完全占据的地面真理部分. 我们采用基于CD的匈牙利语在剩余地面真实部分和生成部分之间进行匹配,以获得一对一的通信。 我们只通过匹配的对来计算部分层面的衡量标准;没有匹配的地面事实和生成的部件不计入额外处罚。 基于这些配对,我们报告部分CD,以测量几何偏差。 此外,我们利用部分界限框IoU(IoU B)对粗度进行空间配对,并使用表面的Voxel IoU(IoU V)对细纹重叠进行评估。 为了处理非水密几何,我们根据距离场而不是内部填充来定义占用. 具体来说,我们使用一个 voxel 网格,其发音为 h vox = 0.03 h_{\ mathrm{vox}}= 0.03,如果一个 voxel 与最近的网格表面的距离小于或等于 hvox h_{\ mathrm{vox}}],则该网格被认为是占用的. 常态最长的轴跨度大约为67伏克赛尔,它在所有方法中固定. 除另有说明外,基准箱由口罩产生,点数从相应的口罩区域抽取.

blocks.en: A.2 Baseline Protocol and Data Lineage
blocks.zh: A.2 基线协议和数据线

blocks.en: All baselines use official checkpoints, without retraining or fine-tuning. TRELLIS and TripoSG receive an image, with multi-view SAM3D lifting for part evaluation; PartCrafter receives an image and GT part count; PartPacker receives only an image; OmniPart receives an image and GT-derived 2D masks; FullPart receives an image and GT 3D boxes. We re-evaluate every method using the same view selection, shape normalization, ICP alignment, and metrics. The main table is a system-level comparison with different inputs and training sets. Controlled comparisons use mask inputs for OmniPart, 3D boxes for FullPart, and part count for PartCrafter.
blocks.zh: 所有基线都使用官方检查站,不进行再培训和微调。 TRELIS和TripoSG接收一个图像,其中多视图的SAM3D提升用于部分评价;PartCrafter接收一个图像和GT部分计数;PartPacker只接收一个图像;OmniPart接收一个图像和GT衍生的2D口罩;FullPart接收一个图像和GT3D盒. 我们使用相同的观点选择、形状正常化、比较方案调整和衡量标准,重新评估每一种方法。 主要表格是系统一级与不同投入和培训组合的比较。 控制比较对 OmniPart 使用掩码输入,对 FullPart 使用 3D 框,对 PartCrafter 使用部分计数.

blocks.en: A.3 Alignment Implementation and Overhead
blocks.zh: A.3 统一执行和间接费用

blocks.en: We use 50 log-domain Sinkhorn iterations with a learnable dustbin score and temperature. The box/mask fusion weight is α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 , and the auxiliary alignment loss weight is λ aux = 1.0 \lambda_{\mathrm{aux}}=1.0 . The alignment branch has 1.18M parameters (0.077% of the model), and transport matrices are at most 33 × 33 33\times 33 . An fp16 profile on one NVIDIA H20 GPU, with 8 parts and 1024 latent tokens per part, measures 8.9 ms for this branch versus 525 ms for the DiT forward pass (1.70%). This measures forward-pass overhead in the profiled configuration, not total training throughput.
blocks.zh: 我们使用50个对数域 Sinkhorn 迭代 和可学习的尘封分和温度。 盒/掩体聚变重量为α = 0.5\alpha = 0.5,辅助对齐减重为+ aux = 1.0\lambda = mathrm{aux = 1.0. 对齐分支有1.18M参数(占模型的0.077%),运输矩阵最多33×3333\时33. 一个NVIDIA H20 GPU上的fp16剖面图,每个部分有8个部件和1024个潜在符号,这个分支测量8.9 ms,而DiT前进通道测量525 ms(1.70%)。 这种方法衡量的是配置图中的前行管理费用,而不是培训总吞吐量。

blocks.en: Appendix B Conditioning Route Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录B 条件 路线分析

blocks.en: We compare Gated AdaLN with injecting geometric prompt tokens into the pretrained image cross-attention pathway. The token-injection variant uses the full training schedule. Under mask conditioning, it performs worse than Gated AdaLN and the count-conditioned PartCrafter reference (Table 6 ). A possible explanation is competition between prompt tokens and the 257 DINOv2 tokens within one attention softmax; the separate modulation route avoids this competition. This diagnostic supports our choice for this backbone, without establishing a general disadvantage of cross-attention conditioning.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了Gated AdaLN和注射几何速记符号 进入预先训练的图像交叉注意路径。 符号注入变体使用完整的训练时间表. 在口罩调节下,其性能比Gated AdaLN和计数条件的PartCrafter参考(表6)更差. 一种可能的解释是,即时符与257的DINOv2令牌在一个注意软马克的内部竞争;单独的调制路线避免了这种竞争. 这种诊断支持我们选择这个骨干,而没有确立交叉注意力调节的一般缺点.

blocks.en: Table 6: Conditioning routes under mask input on PartVerseXL. PartCrafter is a reference using part count and no spatial prompts, not a matched-condition ablation.
blocks.zh: 表6: PartVerseXL上口罩输入下的附加条件路线. PartCrafter是使用部分计数的参考文献,没有空间提示,而不是匹配条件的衰减.

blocks.en: Appendix C Analysis of Asymmetric Geometric Guidance
blocks.zh: 附录C 不对称几何指导分析

blocks.en: C.1 Effect of Stop-Gradient Design
blocks.zh: C.1 停步设计的效果

blocks.en: Table 7 : Ablation on the Stop-Gradient Design in Geometric Guidance. "w/ Grad" allows the alignment loss to update the teacher prompt embeddings, while "wo/ Grad" (our default) stops gradients at the box/mask embeddings before the Visual Bridge.
blocks.zh: 表7: 几何指引中停止-渐变设计上的偏差. "w/Grad"允许对齐损失更新老师的即时嵌入,而"wo/Grad"(我们的默认)则在Visual Bridge之前的框/mask嵌入上停止梯度.

blocks.en: We further analyze the effect of the stop-gradient design in geometric guidance. We find that it primarily affects whole-mesh reconstruction quality across different prompt granularities. As shown in Tab. 7 , enabling gradient flow (w/ Grad) slightly improves performance under sparse point prompts, reducing CD from 0.1525 to 0.1518. However, it degrades performance under stronger geometric conditions, including both box and mask prompts, where CD increases from 0.1447 to 0.1531 and from 0.1418 to 0.1512, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析在几何制导中停止升级设计的效果. 我们认为,它主要影响不同颗粒的整层重建质量。 如塔布所示. 7,允许梯度流(w/Grad)在稀释点提示下会略微改善性能,将CD从0.1525减少到0.1518. 然而,它在较强的几何条件下,包括盒式和罩式导电符下,会降低性能,其中CD分别从0.1447升至0.1531和0.1418升至0.1512.

blocks.en: This behavior suggests that allowing gradients leads to overly symmetric optimization, where strong and weak prompts are pulled toward each other in representation space. Our goal is to guide weak point representations using strong geometric priors while preventing the alignment loss from updating the teacher prompt embeddings. We stop gradients at box/mask embeddings before the Visual Bridge.
blocks.zh: 这种行为表明允许梯度会导致过度对称优化,其中在代表空间中相互拉动强弱的提示. 我们的目标是用强几何前缀来引导弱点表示,同时防止校对丢失更新老师的即时嵌入. 我们在视觉桥前的盒子/面具嵌入处停止梯度.

blocks.en: C.2 Partial OT versus Contrastive Alignment
blocks.zh: C.2 部分OT与对齐

blocks.en: We evaluate whether partial optimal transport (OT) improves generation beyond a simpler contrastive alignment objective. We train an InfoNCE variant from the same initialization and with the same training budget, changing only the alignment loss. Table 8 reports the resulting part-level generation metrics on PartVerseXL. Partial OT achieves lower Part CD and higher voxel and bounding-box IoU under all three prompt conditions. In particular, under point prompts, Part CD decreases from 0.3499 to 0.3334. This experiment evaluates the alignment objective in end-to-end generation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价部分最佳运输(OT)是否在较简单的对比性对齐目标之外改进发电。 我们从相同的初始化和相同的培训预算来训练InfoNCE的变体,只改变校对损失. 表8报告了在PartVerseXL上得出的部分生成量度。 部分OT在所有三个即时条件下都实现较低的Part CD和更高的Voxel和边框IoU. 尤其是,在点提示下,CD部分从0.3499减少到0.3334。 这一实验评价了端到端生成中的对齐目标.

blocks.en: Table 8: End-to-end comparison of alignment losses on PartVerseXL. Only the alignment loss is changed; initialization and training budget are held fixed. IoU V and IoU B denote part-level voxel and bounding-box IoU, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表8:部分VerseXL的对齐损失的端对端比较. 只有调整损失被改变;初始化和培训预算被固定。 木卫五和木卫五 B 分别表示部分等级的 voxel 和 边框 IoU 。

blocks.en: C.3 Global Assignment on Frozen Features
blocks.zh: C.3 全球冻土任务

blocks.en: Known part correspondences provide diagonal supervision during training, but point features can still be ambiguous among similar strong priors. Paired L2 alignment treats each known pair independently, while InfoNCE normalizes similarities independently within each point row. Neither imposes a column marginal on the induced matching. Sinkhorn instead couples the assignments through both row and column marginals, introducing competition among points for the available priors.
blocks.zh: 已知的部分通信在培训期间提供对角监督,但点的特征在类似的强前科中仍然可能模糊不清. Paired L2对齐独立处理每个已知对对对,而InfoNCE则在每一点行内独立实现相似性正常化. 也不会在诱导匹配上强制设置列边框 。 而Sinkhorn则通过行边和列边进行任务配对,对已有前科的分数进行竞争。

blocks.en: To isolate this assignment effect, we freeze the trained model and use 199 PartObjaverse-Tiny objects containing 1,330 parts. Point, box, and mask prompts are derived from each ground-truth part as in training. We run only the prompt encoders, visual bridge, and DINOv2 feature extractor, without diffusion sampling or mesh decoding. We then apply row-wise similarity matching and Sinkhorn to the same similarity matrix. Top-1 matching measures correct point-to-prior matches, while many-to-one collapse measures duplicated prior selections by multiple points.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离这种分配效应,我们冻结了训练有素的模型,并使用了包含1,330个部件的199个PartObjaverse-Tiny对象. 点、盒和面具提示都来自训练中的每个地面真实部分。 我们只运行快速编码器,视觉桥, 和DINOv2特征提取器, 没有扩散取样或网格解码。 然后,我们采用逐行相似度比对和Sinkhorn对相同的相似度矩阵。 Top-1匹配度量正确点对点匹配,而许多点对点的崩溃度量则以多个点重复先前的选择.

blocks.en: Table 9: Assignment-operator diagnostic on the same frozen features. These are feature-matching results, rather than generation metrics or separate L2/InfoNCE training experiments.
blocks.zh: 表9:同一冻结特征的指定操作员诊断。 这些是特征匹配的结果,而不是生成度量衡或单独的L2/InfoNCE培训实验.

blocks.en: On normalized features, an InfoNCE similarity argmax and an L2 nearest-neighbor readout both reduce to row-wise similarity matching, although their training objectives differ. As shown in Table 9 , Sinkhorn improves Top-1 matching from 0.803 to 0.895 and reduces many-to-one collapse by approximately 5.5 × 5.5\times . Ambiguity is particularly pronounced for symmetric parts: row-wise matching accuracy is 0.516 for symmetric pairs, compared with 0.931 for other pairs. These observations support global competition for resolving ambiguous feature correspondences.
blocks.zh: 在规范化的特性上,一个 InfoNCE 相似性 argmax 和一个 L2 近邻读出都降低到逐行相似性匹配,尽管它们的训练目标不同. 如表9所示,Sinkhorn改进了Top-1的比对,从0.803提高到0.895,并将多对一的崩溃减少约5.5×5.5\时。 对称部分的模糊度特别显著:对称对称的排位匹配精度为0.516,而其他对称则为0.931. 这些意见支持解决模棱两可的特征通信的全球竞争。

blocks.en: C.4 Dustbin for Unmatched Priors
blocks.zh: C.4 未匹配前题的尘封

blocks.en: The dustbin addresses a separate issue: unmatched entries in batch-level alignment. In the same frozen-feature diagnostic, we append four box-prior columns from another object, none of which corresponds to a part of the current object. We compare strict OT with partial OT using the dustbin under this shared distractor setting. As shown in Table 10 , partial OT improves Top-1 matching from 0.677 to 0.747. The dustbin supplies a channel for unmatched mass, relaxing the requirement to assign mass to irrelevant priors. Together with the preceding diagnostic, this separates the role of global competition among valid matches from the role of unmatched-mass handling.
blocks.zh: 灰盒处理一个单独的问题:在批量级对齐中未匹配的条目. 在同一冷冻-地貌诊断中,我们从另一个对象中附加了四个盒前列,其中没有一个对应当前对象的一部分. 我们把严格的OT与部分OT进行比较,在这种共享的分散器设置下使用尘封. 如表10所示,部分OT改进了Top-1的配比,从0.677提高到0.747. 尘封提供无匹配质量的通道,放松了将质量分配到无关前题的要求. 与前面的诊断一样,这把有效匹配中全球竞争的作用与无法匹配的质量处理的作用区分开来。

blocks.en: Table 10: Frozen-feature diagnostic with four cross-object box-prior distractors. Both variants receive the same augmented set of priors; the distractors have no valid correspondence in the current object.
blocks.zh: 表10:用四个交叉对象的盒前分流器进行冰层诊断. 两种变体都收到相同的增强前缀;分散器在当前对象中没有有效的对应.

blocks.en: Appendix D Adaptability to Input Variations
blocks.zh: 附录D 对输入变量的适应性

blocks.en: Table 11 : Analysis of the adaptability to user input variations.
blocks.zh: 表11:用户输入变量适应性分析.

blocks.en: We evaluate FlexPart under noisy, partial, and heterogeneous inputs through controlled experiments that approximate common user input variations. Drawn bounding boxes may be misaligned, loosely cover target parts, or specify only a subset of components.
blocks.zh: 我们通过接近普通用户输入变化的受控实验,在吵闹、片面和多样的投入下评价FlexPart。 绘图边框可能错配,松散覆盖目标部件,或者只指定一个组件子集.

blocks.en: Perturbed bounding boxes. We simulate noisy user annotations by randomly offsetting the position and size of each input 2D bounding box by up to 20%. This perturbation tests the model’s tolerance to spatial inaccuracy while preserving approximate part localization.
blocks.zh: 扰动的束缚箱。 我们模拟吵闹的用户说明,随机抵消每个输入2D边框的位置和大小,最多可达20%. 这种扰动测试了模型对空间不准确的耐受性,同时保留了大约部分局部化.

blocks.en: Partial box specification. To reflect scenarios where users focus on only a subset of parts, we provide bounding boxes for half of the parts and use point prompts for the remaining parts. This hybrid setting evaluates whether strong and weak geometric prompts can be jointly exploited within the unified framework.
blocks.zh: 部分框规格。 为了反映用户只关注子集部件的情景,我们为一半部件提供边框,为其余部件提供使用点提示。 这种混合环境评价了强弱的几何导体是否能够在统一框架内共同利用.

blocks.en: Mixed-condition specification. To further assess the effectiveness of our unified framework, we consider a mixed condition setting that is never observed during training. Specifically, we provide 2D masks for half of the parts and 2D bounding boxes for the remaining parts. This setting evaluates whether FlexPart can seamlessly integrate heterogeneous strong priors and generalize to novel combinations of geometric conditions.
blocks.zh: 混合条件规格。 为了进一步评估我们统一框架的有效性,我们认为在培训期间从未遵守过的一种混合条件。 具体来说,我们为一半的部件提供2D口罩,为其余部件提供2D边框. 这种设定评价FlexPart是否能够无缝地融合各种强前缀,并概括到几何条件的新组合.

blocks.en: Minimal input with part count only. We also consider the extreme case where users specify only the desired number of parts. Since FlexPart requires at least point-level spatial prompts, we automatically derive point prompts from the input image. Specifically, we extract high-resolution patch features 𝐟 patch \mathbf{f}_{\mathrm{patch}} using DINOv2. To improve spatial consistency, we incorporate the 2D coordinates 𝐱 patch \mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{patch}} of each patch to form a joint representation 𝐯 patch = [ 𝐟 patch ∥ ω sp 𝐱 patch ] \mathbf{v}_{\mathrm{patch}}=[\mathbf{f}_{\mathrm{patch}}\parallel\omega_{\mathrm{sp}}\mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{patch}}] , where the spatial weight is set to ω sp = 5.0 \omega_{\mathrm{sp}}=5.0 . We then perform spectral clustering on this combined representation using k = 15 k=15 nearest neighbors to obtain point prompts from the cluster centroids. In our preliminary experiments, we compared several clustering methods, including K-means and hierarchical clustering; however, spectral clustering consistently yielded the best performance in capturing semantically and spatially coherent part structures. This strategy enables effective part generation even from minimal input, and outperforms PartCrafter when only part counts are provided.
blocks.zh: 只有部分数的最小输入 。 我们还认为,用户只指明所需零件数量的极端情况。 由于FlexPart需要至少点级的空间提示,我们自动从输入图像中得出点提示. 具体来说,我们利用DINOv2提取高分辨率补丁特性f补丁\mathbf{f}_{\mathrm{patch} 为了提高空间一致性,我们将每个补丁中的2D坐标x补丁\mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{patch}组成一个联合表示 v补丁=[f补丁\xspx补丁]\mathbf{v}_{\mathrm{patch}[\mathbf{f}_{\mathrm{patch}[\mathbfpathb}}\xex\m_{\mathrm{patch}}],其中空间重量被设定为Qωsp=5.0\mega_{\mathrm{sp}}=5.0. 然后我们利用 k = 15 k = 15 近邻 来进行光谱集聚,从组群的中间体中获取点提示。 在我们的初步实验中,我们比较了几种集群方法,包括K-手段和分级集群;然而,光谱集群在捕捉集成和空间连贯的部分结构方面始终取得了最佳的性能。 这一策略即使从最低限度的输入也能够有效生成部分,并且当仅提供部分计数时,其性能超过了PartCrafter.

blocks.en: The quantitative results for these controlled input variations are summarized in Tab. 11 . The results demonstrate a clear trade-off between the strength of geometric conditions and generation accuracy: stronger inputs provide more precise part localization, while weaker inputs offer greater flexibility with reduced supervision. Crucially, thanks to its unified multi-granularity design, FlexPart consistently maintains reasonable performance across all input settings and generalizes well to noisy, partial, and mixed conditions. This highlights the advantage of a unified framework that seamlessly integrates heterogeneous user inputs for robust, practical interactive 3D part generation.
blocks.zh: 这些可控输入变量的量化结果摘要载于Tab. 11。 结果显示,几何条件的强度与生成准确度之间有明显的权衡:更强的投入提供了更精确的部分本地化,而更弱的投入则提供了更大的灵活性,减少了监督。 关键是,由于FlexPart的统一多角度设计,FlexPart在所有输入设置中始终保持合理的性能,并很好地概括到吵闹,片面和混合的条件. 这突出表明了统一框架的优点,即能无缝地整合各种用户投入,以形成强有力的、实用的交互式3D部分。

blocks.en: Complementary evaluation with human-provided point and box prompts is reported in App. E .
blocks.zh: App.E报告了与人提供的点和框提示的补充评价。

blocks.en: Appendix E Evaluation with Human-Provided Prompts
blocks.zh: 附录E 带有人为提示的评价

blocks.en: The controlled perturbations in App. D approximate common input errors. To complement them with actual human-provided prompts, we invite three annotators to mark their intended parts on the input images of 50 PartObjaverse-Tiny objects using points and 2D bounding boxes. Every evaluated input contains both prompt types; this study evaluates joint point-and-box input. Table 12 reports the mean and standard deviation of the evaluation scores across the three annotators.
blocks.zh: App中受控扰动. D 大致常见输入错误。 为了补充它们,我们请三个注释员在使用点数和2D边框的50个PartObjaverse-Tiny物体的输入图像上标出其预定部分。 每个被评价的输入都包含两种即时类型;本研究评价联合点与框输入. 表12报告三个注释员的评价分数的平均值和标准差。

blocks.en: Table 12: Human-provided prompts on 50 PartObjaverse-Tiny objects. All inputs contain both points and 2D boxes. Values are mean ± \pm standard deviation across three annotators. IoU V and IoU B denote part-level voxel and bounding-box IoU, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表12:对50个PartObjaverse-Tiny物体提供的人类提示。 所有输入都包含两个点和2D框. 值是平均±\\pm 标准偏差,跨越三个注释器. IoU V 和 IoU B 分别表示部分级别 voxel 和 边框 IoU.

blocks.en: We compute these metrics against the dataset parts after Hungarian matching. Since an annotator’s intended decomposition may differ from the dataset annotation, the scores serve as reference measurements of agreement with the dataset, rather than strict measures of whether the user’s intended decomposition is satisfied. The observed cross-annotator variation suggests limited sensitivity to the annotator within this study. This small-scale evaluation provides evidence for generation with human-provided spatial prompts, but does not measure interaction time or downstream usability. Complementary qualitative results with manually provided point or box prompts are shown in Fig. 9 .
blocks.zh: 我们用匈牙利匹配后的数据组部分来计算这些指标。 由于注释员的预期分解可能不同于数据集的注释,因此计分数可以作为与数据集一致的参考度量,而不是衡量用户的预期分解是否得到满足的严格度量. 观察到的交叉注释者变化表明,本研究中对注释者的敏感性有限。 这种小规模评价为利用人提供的空间提示进行生成提供了证据,但并不衡量相互作用的时间或下游可用性。 图9显示了人工提供的点或框提示的补充质量结果。

blocks.en: Appendix F Part Generation Efficiency
blocks.zh: 附录F 部分生成效率

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Efficiency comparison between FlexPart and other methods.
blocks.zh: 图5:FlexPart与其他方法的效率比较。

blocks.en:
Beyond accuracy, we evaluate efficiency in terms of inference latency and memory usage.
Specifically, we measure the average time required to generate a single part, covering the entire process from condition encoding to final mesh extraction. Additionally, we analyze peak GPU memory (VRAM) consumption during object generation with varying numbers of parts. All evaluations are conducted on a single NVIDIA A800 GPU using random instances from the PartVerseXL validation set.
blocks.zh:
除了准确性以外,我们还从推断延迟和记忆使用的角度评价效率。
具体来说,我们测量生成单个部分所需的平均时间,涵盖从条件编码到最终网格提取的整个过程. 此外,我们分析GPU内存(VRAM)在物体生成过程中的峰值消耗,其部件数量不一. 所有评价都是在单NVIDIA A800 GPU上进行的,使用来自PartVerseXL验证集的随机实例.

blocks.en: Regarding inference speed, Fig. 5 (a) illustrates that FlexPart achieves competitive performance relative to existing baselines. Although our method shares a similar Diffusion Transformer backbone with PartCrafter [ 20 ] , we concatenate part identity embeddings with the latent code rather than adding them directly. This design choice introduces a slight computational overhead during attention operations, resulting in a marginal increase in inference latency. Compared to two-stage approaches like OmniPart [ 46 ] , which accelerates generation via latent downsampling, our method operates at a higher resolution and thus requires more computation. FlexPart strikes a balanced trade-off between generation quality and speed, leaving potential for further acceleration in future work.
blocks.zh: 关于推论速度,图5(a)说明FlexPart相对于现有基线而言,其业绩具有竞争力。 虽然我们的方法与PartCrafter [20] 共享一个类似的扩散变形器主干线,但我们将部分身份嵌入到潜在的代码中而不是直接添加. 这种设计选择引入了在关注操作中略微增加的计算间接费用,导致推论延迟性略有增加. 与OmniPart [46] 等通过潜在下取样加速生成的两阶段方法相比,我们的方法以更高的分辨率运作,因此需要更多的计算. FlexPart在生成质量和速度之间达成了平衡的权衡,为未来工作进一步加速留下了潜力.

blocks.en: In terms of memory consumption, as shown in Fig. 5 (b), FlexPart maintains a modest peak VRAM footprint of ∼ \sim 6GB to 8GB, which is comparable to the lightweight baseline PartCrafter [ 20 ] . In contrast, dense generation methods such as OmniPart [ 46 ] and FullPart [ 8 ] demand significantly higher resources, consuming nearly twice the memory under identical settings. Furthermore, our approach exhibits robust scalability with respect to object complexity. When doubling the target part count from 8 to 16, the peak memory usage increases only marginally. This footprint suggests that consumer GPUs with sufficient VRAM can support complex multi-part generation.
blocks.zh: 在内存消耗方面,如图5(b)所示,FlexPart保持了\\sim 6GB至8GB的适量峰值VRAM脚印,这可与轻量级基线PartCrafter [20] 相当. 相比之下,OmniPart [46] 和FullPart [8] 等密集生成方法需要相当高的资源,在相同的设置下消耗了近两倍的内存. 此外,在物体复杂性方面,我们的方法显示出强大的可扩展性。 当目标部分从8个翻一番到16个时,顶峰内存使用量只略有增加。 这个足迹表明具有足够VRAM的消费GPU可以支持复杂的多段生成.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Qualitative analysis of point placement under four sampling strategies: Center, Offset, Edge, and Cluster.
blocks.zh: 图6:根据四个取样战略对点位置进行定性分析:中心、偏移、边缘和集群。

blocks.en: We investigate how point placement affects generation quality across input modalities, focusing on spatial ambiguity and the role of point prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们调查点位置如何影响各种输入模式的生成质量,重点是空间模糊和点提示的作用。

blocks.en:
Quantitative Analysis. As shown in Tab. 13 , the sensitivity to point placement strongly depends on the availability of additional geometric priors.
When using Point Only inputs, the model exhibits clear sensitivity to suboptimal point locations. In particular, sampling points near object boundaries ( Edge ) leads to a substantial degradation across all metrics, with CD increasing from 0.3302 to 0.4190 and IoU V dropping from 0.1905 to 0.1342, indicating greater spatial ambiguity without supporting cues.
blocks.zh:
定量分析。 如Tab.13所示,点位置的灵敏度在很大程度上取决于是否有其他几何前缀。
使用点时 只有投入,模型显示出对次最佳点位置的明显敏感性. 特别是,物体边界(边缘)附近的采样点导致所有度量计的大幅降解,CD从0.3302上升到0.4190,IoU V从0.1905下降到0.1342,表明空间模糊度较大,没有支持提示。

blocks.en: In contrast, when stronger geometric conditions such as bounding boxes or masks are provided, the influence of point placement becomes significantly less pronounced. For example, under the Point + Box setting, the variation across different strategies remains within a narrow range (e.g., CD varies only from 0.3036 to 0.3178), indicating stable performance. A similar trend is observed for Point + Mask , where IoU V fluctuates marginally between 0.1962 and 0.2088, suggesting that geometric priors effectively dominate the spatial reasoning process.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,当提供较强的几何条件,如捆绑箱或口罩时,点布置的影响就会明显减少。 例如,在Point + Box设置下,不同战略之间的差异仍然在狭义范围内(例如,CD只从0.3036到0.3178不等),表明性能稳定. Point + Mask 也有类似趋势,IoU V在0.1962至0.2088之间稍有波动,这表明几何前缀实际上主导了空间推理过程.

blocks.en: Qualitative Analysis. Consistent with the quantitative findings, our qualitative results shown in Fig. 6 visualize the generation outcomes under the four point sampling strategies in the Point Only setting. The visual comparison clearly demonstrates how ambiguous point inputs, such as those near the edges, lead to a loss of geometric fidelity.
blocks.zh: 定性分析. 与定量结果一致,我们在图6中显示的质量结果可视化出四点取样战略下的生成结果。 视觉比较清楚地显示,诸如边缘附近的输入点的模糊性会导致几何忠诚度的丧失。

blocks.en: Overall, while FlexPart is sensitive to point locations under point-only conditions, its sensitivity to point placement is substantially reduced when stronger geometric prompts are also provided.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,虽然FlexPart在只点条件下对点位置很敏感,但当也提供更强的几何提示时,其对点位置的敏感度大幅降低.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Qualitative evaluation of the SAM-based interface. We compare generation results under two input conditions across diverse examples. SAM : masks generated by SAM from a single point prompt sampled near the visual center. GT : ground-truth segmentation masks.
blocks.zh: 图7:基于SAM的界面定性评价. 我们比较了不同实例在两个输入条件下的生成结果。 SAM:由SAM从视觉中心附近的单点即时采样生成的口罩. GT:地面真伪分解口罩.

blocks.en: A seemingly plausible approach is to first convert sparse inputs (e.g., points) into dense masks using a 2D segmentation model such as Segment Anything (SAM) [ 14 ] , followed by mask-conditioned 3D generation. We analyze this pipeline to understand whether such a decomposition can replace direct modeling of sparse conditions.
blocks.zh: 一个看似可行的方法是首先将稀疏的输入(如点数)转换成密集的口罩,使用二维分解模型,如Side Anything(SAM)[14],然后是带口罩的3D生成. 我们分析这个管道,以了解这种分解是否能取代对稀有条件的直接建模.

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 14 , generation conditioned on SAM-derived masks performs worse than generation conditioned on ground-truth masks under both evaluated point sampling strategies. Even with center-based point sampling, CD degrades from 0.2938 to 0.3387, and IoU V drops from 0.2049 to 0.1731. Direct point conditioning achieves Part CD 0.3334, IoU V 0.1902, and IoU B 0.2506, outperforming both SAM-derived mask settings under the same evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 如附件14所示,在两个评估点取样战略下,以SAM衍生口罩为条件的生成比以地面真实口罩为条件的生成情况更糟糕。 即使采用中点取样,CD也从0.2938降解至0.3387,IoU V从0.2049降至0.1731. 直接点定能实现CD 0.3334,IoU V 0.1902和IoU B 0.2506,均优于同一评价协议下的SAM衍生面具设置.

blocks.en: This performance gap may reflect a mismatch between image segmentation and the intended 3D part decomposition. As visualized in Fig. 7 , given a sparse prompt, SAM typically segments a localized fragment rather than the complete functional part intended by the user. Incomplete intermediate masks can propagate segmentation errors into 3D generation.
blocks.zh: 这种性能差距可能反映了图像分割与预期的3D部分分解之间的不匹配. 如图7所示,由于瞬间不多,SAM通常将局部片段隔开,而不是用户想要的完整功能部分。 不完整的中间口罩可以将分割错误传播到3D生成中.

blocks.en: In contrast, our end-to-end framework avoids this by directly modeling heterogeneous conditions. This joint modeling enables cross-modal synergy, allowing the network to learn robust semantics directly from sparse prompts. Furthermore, it naturally scales to structured 3D conditions like 3D bounding boxes, which cannot be elegantly reduced to 2D masks.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,我们的端到端框架通过直接模拟各种条件来避免这种情况。 这种联合建模可以实现跨模式协同,使网络能够直接从稀疏的提示中学习强健的语义. 此外,它自然缩放到结构化的3D条件,如3D捆绑箱,这些条件不能被优雅地简化为2D口罩.

blocks.en: To further substantiate the versatility of FlexPart, we provide extended qualitative results in Fig. 8 across a spectrum of geometric conditions. In addition, we present a new set of visualizations in Fig. 9 focusing on objects with highly complex topological structures. By directly leveraging image conditioning alongside user-provided point or box prompts, our method successfully synthesizes high-quality, part-level 3D objects that preserve intricate geometric details.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步证实FlexPart的多功能性,我们在图8中提供了跨越各种几何条件的延伸质量结果。 此外,我们还在图9中提出了一套新的可视化,侧重于地形结构高度复杂的物体. 通过在用户提供的点或框提示的同时直接利用图像配置,我们的方法成功地合成了保存复杂几何细节的高质量,部分级的3D对象.

blocks.en: These combined results highlight the core advantage of our unified framework, which empowers users to flexibly choose the most suitable prompt type for their specific needs. Regardless of the input modality, from lightweight points to dense masks, FlexPart consistently produces high-fidelity meshes with clean topology and precise alignment to the provided spatial layouts, demonstrating robust generalization across diverse interaction modes.
blocks.zh: 这些综合成果突出了我们统一框架的核心优势,它使用户能够灵活选择最合适的即时类型来满足其具体需求。 无论输入方式如何,从轻量点到密集的口罩,FlexPart始终以干净的地形和精确的与所提供的空间布局对齐的方式生产出高纯度的中间体,显示出各种相互作用模式的强烈概括。
